resources.string: Create a link in Relayium on your other device, then paste the link or enter its six-digit code here.
Once connected, you can send and receive files and messages.
Enter the six-digit code from your other device.
A pairing code is exactly six digits, for example 004291.
That link is not a relayium.com transfer link.
That is a stored-file link. This app joins live transfers between two devices that are both open.
That link has no pairing code in it.
Both devices should show the same six digits. They are not the pairing code.
That code is not active. Codes expire after a few minutes — ask your other device for a fresh one.
Could not reach Relayium. Check this device\'s connection and try again.
The other device is already connected to something else.
The other device is running a version of Relayium this app cannot connect to. Update it and try again.
The connection could not be verified and was stopped. Start a new session.
The connection ended. Nothing more can arrive on it — start a new session to continue.
The transfer stopped and was not completed.
The received file did not match what was sent, so it was discarded. Nothing was saved.
The file could not be saved.
There is not enough free space on this device for this transfer.
The other device sent a folder layout this app will not create. Nothing was saved.
Messages stopped working on this connection. Start a new session to continue.
The connection is busy. Wait a moment and send again.
Some partial files from a cancelled transfer could not be removed. Check your chosen folder and delete anything you did not expect.
The size of “%1$s” could not be read, so it cannot be sent. Try a different file or copy it locally first.
One of the chosen files could not be read. Nothing was sent.
That folder could not be opened. Choose a different folder.
Messages you send appear here. They are never stored anywhere.
The other device would like to start a conversation.
This message is longer than one message can carry (%1$d of %2$d bytes).
Waiting for the other device to accept the conversation…
Messages stopped working on this connection. Files may still work; a new session restores messages.
Accepted. Waiting for data from the other device…
Files can no longer be sent on this connection. Messages still work — start a new session to send files again.
Waiting for the other device to accept…
Delivered. The other device confirmed every file arrived intact.
Version %1$s is the newest published version.
No download is published right now.

This opens github.com in your browser. Relayium does not download or install anything itself — you choose to open the file, and Android installs it only if it was signed with the same certificate as this app.
No app on this device could open that link. Copy this address into a browser:
Could not reach the update server. Check this device\'s connection and try again.
The update server did not answer in time. Try again later.
The update server returned an unexpected response, so nothing could be checked.
The update information was larger than expected and was refused.
The update information could not be read, so nothing could be checked.
The update information did not come from an official Relayium release and was refused.
Get a six-digit code and a link the other device can open. It works across networks.
Creating a link needs an account: what the link transfers counts toward that account\'s monthly allowance. Joining a link never needs one.
That code could not be used, because this device had already started another session. Create a new one.
Give these to the other device
Enter the code in Relayium on the other device, or open this link there:
This code has expired. Disconnect and create a new one.
Or open a link you were given
Sign in to create links from this device and to see your plan and devices.
We will email you a link to confirm your address. You can sign in once you have opened it.
Don\'t have an account? Create one
Already have an account? Sign in
If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Open it in a browser to choose a new password.
For accounts that sign in with Apple or Google, approve this device in a browser where you are already signed in.
Open the page below and confirm this code:
A browser approval is in progress. Cancel it below to sign in with a password instead.
Open the link we sent to %1$s. Until then this account cannot sign in.
Asked. If that address is waiting to be confirmed, another email is on its way.
This account is scheduled for deletion
It will be permanently removed after %1$s, and cannot sign in until it is restored. Use the restore link in the email sent when the deletion was requested.
These figures could not be refreshed just now, so they may be out of date.
You are signed in, but this device could not store the credential — you will have to sign in again after closing the app.
You are signed in, but your account could not be loaded.
Your credential could NOT be revoked, so it may still be usable. It has been kept on this device so you can try again.
You were signed out and the credential was revoked, but it could not be removed from this device. It no longer works.
This device has a stored sign-in it can no longer read. That happens after a factory reset or a screen-lock change. Sign in again to replace it.
Discard it and sign in again
No devices are signed in to this account.
Never used since it was added
“%1$s” will be signed out and will need to sign in again.
“%1$s” is this device. Removing it signs you out here.
Could not reach Relayium. Check this device\'s connection and try again.
Relayium did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
The answer was larger than expected and was refused.
Relayium answered something this app could not read, so nothing was changed.
Relayium answered unexpectedly (%1$d), so nothing was changed.
Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
That email and password do not match an account.
That does not look like an email address.
An account already exists for that address. Sign in instead.
An account for that address is scheduled for deletion. Use the restore link that was emailed, or try again once the grace period ends.
The approval was refused in the browser.
The approval was not completed in time. Start again.
Relayium named an approval page that is not on relayium.com, so it was not opened.
This account has used its transfer allowance for the month, so a cross-network link would not be able to carry anything. Transfers on the same network are unaffected.
No code could be created just now. Try again in a moment.
Relayium answered with a code this app will not show. Nothing was created.
The sign-in stored on this device cannot be used. Sign in again to replace it.
